Results.ReviewText:
My mother-in-law purchased this as a replacement for my Silver B.  Things weren't going well with that one.  The first thing I was disappointed with was the orientation of the burners.  They run vertically in the grill as opposed to the Silver B's horizontal configuration.  This is a problem because of the way the convection is used during indirect heating.  I suspected this new grill would not heat the same, and I was correct.  It takes much longer to preheat and burn off debris than the Silver B.
I do like the electric start button and the large knobs.  It lights right up, but it is new, so I don't know how long that will last.  The handle stays cool, which is another plus.  I was frustrated to find the chrome coated metal "bun warmer" situated on top of the cast iron grate.  You'd think they could make the bun warmer of the same material to make it last longer.  I use it as a place to cook hot dogs while grilling hamburgers.  It would be nice if there was a bumper on either side so the dogs didn't roll off the ends.
The gas gauge appears to not be reliable; not surprised because it's very stiff.
Cooking has gone relatively well.  I was not expecting it to work as well as my Silver B because of the burner configuration.  However, food is cooked evenly across the large surface.  There are no hot and cold spots like my Silver B, which, I suppose is a good thing.  The grate is easy to work with and somewhat easy to clean.  I have not cooked a bird on it yet, but I am concerned about the shallowness of the lid and how well it will handle larger birds. 
Overall I am pleased with the cooking experience.  I suppose it will take some getting used to.
Results.Title: Replacement for my old Silver B

Results.ReviewText: I assemble my new grill which took a little time but was very easy.   I have been using the grill for over a few months with no concerning issues.  It cooks evenly and warms up very quickly.   It’s a weber so it should last over 10yrs, I hope.  My weber charcoal grill is over 13yrs old and still works great so no worries with my latest purchase.  The only thing I don’t like about the grill is the drop down shelf on left side.  When I go to wheel the grill over to a location the drop down shelf is not the best thing to hold on to while trying to manuver.  You lift up on the shelf to dislodge it from the captive post then drop the shelf down.  Well this also occurs when trying to move grill which is annoying.
Results.Title: Overall a great gas grill!!
